decisions.publicRationale: PEN 65553 is recorded in the IANA Private Enterprise Numbers registry.
Records already published before the structured registry was introduced were imported without changing their numeric OIDs or asserting unrecorded historical facts.
Adopts the structured registry, immutable allocation records, explicit delegation records, and separate object lifecycle states.
Ratifies the existing PKI arc delegation as an explicit, machine-readable administrative instrument.
Allocates a distinct arc for immutable, versioned trust-anchor groups.

decisions.reviewException: Single-operator exception under POL-ROOT-2.0.0 section 5: the repository operator explicitly authorized G6 PKI creation and OID registration in the maintenance request of 2026-10-15. The same accountable operator exercises the naming-authority and delegated-PKI-RA roles. This record does not assert approval by a second person. Bouncy Castle issuance and separate cryptography/OpenSSL checks verify the published key bindings.
decisions.publicRationale: Adopt stable private certificate-policy semantics for managed TLS, S/MIME, code signing, identity and timestamp signers, with 15-year roots, 5-year issuing CAs, 2-year leaf templates, soft keys and CRL-only status distribution.

The same accountable operator exercises the naming-authority and delegated-PKI-RA roles. This record does not assert approval by a second person. Bouncy Castle issuance and separate cryptography/OpenSSL checks verify the published key bindings.
decisions.publicRationale: Allocate the managedTrust certificate-policy family and ten defined leaf identifiers, avoiding private identifiers already used by legacy profiles. The unallocated .10 value is not claimed by this decision.

decisions.reviewException: Single-operator exception under POL-ROOT-2.0.0 section 5: the repository operator explicitly authorized G6 PKI creation and OID registration in the maintenance request of 2026-10-15. The same accountable operator exercises the naming-authority and delegated-PKI-RA roles. This record does not assert approval by a second person. Bouncy Castle issuance and separate cryptography/OpenSSL checks verify the published key bindings.
decisions.publicRationale: Allocate five independently generated G6 roots and immutable trust-anchor group version 0. Code Signing and Timestamp use RSA4096; Server, Mail and Identity use P-384.

decisions.reviewException: Single-operator exception under POL-ROOT-2.0.0 section 5: the repository operator explicitly authorized G6 PKI creation and OID registration in the maintenance request of 2026-10-15. The same accountable operator exercises the naming-authority and delegated-PKI-RA roles. This record does not assert approval by a second person. Bouncy Castle issuance and separate cryptography/OpenSSL checks verify the published key bindings.
decisions.publicRationale: Activate the five root bindings after validating exact SPKI DER, certificate signatures, key sizes/curves, SKI, names, constraints and certificate artifacts exported from the running EJBCA instance.

decisions.reviewException: Single-operator exception under POL-ROOT-2.0.0 section 5: the repository operator explicitly selected direct issuance of cross-certificates by Youngdo Root CA on 2026-10-16. The same accountable operator exercises the naming-authority and delegated-PKI-RA roles. No second person's approval is asserted. Native EJBCA self-signed request verification, separate cryptography extension/signature checks and OpenSSL chain verification were completed before this publication.
decisions.publicRationale: Append five cross-certificate artifacts for the exact previously registered G6 root subjects and public keys. Preserve their original self-signed certificates, OID identity, lifecycle and immutable group version. Cross-certificates use SHA-384/RSA, pathLen=1, CRL-only status and expire no later than Youngdo Root CA on 2040-02-12.

decisions.reviewException: Single-operator exception under POL-ROOT-2.0.0 section 5: the operator explicitly instructed reissuance of G6 roots without AKI, purpose-EKU cross-certificates (Identity anyExtendedKeyUsage), and TLS leaf profiles without SKI. The same accountable operator exercises the naming-authority and delegated-PKI-RA roles; no approval by a second person is asserted. Native EJBCA issuance, independent cryptography checks, OpenSSL basic-path verification and actual CA-purpose checks were completed. The OpenSSL Identity ANY/clientAuth compatibility limitation is documented.
decisions.publicRationale: Append five renewed self-signed root certificates without AKI but with unchanged SKI/SPKI, and five new cross-certificates retaining issuer AKI and using the requested purpose EKUs. Preserve all existing OID identities, original certificates and immutable root group membership. No new private key is generated.

events.summary: Imported all previously published allocations without renumbering or inferring missing cryptographic bindings.
Adopted version 2 governance and data-model policies.
Ratified delegation DLG-2026-0001 as a structured administrative instrument.
Adopted managedTrust policy definitions under the recorded single-operator exception.
Allocated the managedTrust family and ten private certificate-policy identifiers.
Allocated five G6 trust anchors and immutable group version 0 without modifying legacy assignments.
Verified root SPKI/certificate digests and SKI using independent cryptographic implementations and recorded exact artifacts before activation.

Appended five verified cross-certificates with unchanged SPKI and SKI, and published six modern and six old-root-compatible issuing-CA chains. No OID, trust-anchor identity or effective policy is reassigned.

Verified ten reissued certificates with identical registered root keys/SKI, no AKI on five self-signed roots, and exact requested EKUs on cross-certificates. Refreshed six modern and six legacy paths. OpenSSL does not treat the Identity anyExtendedKeyUsage CA EKU as a clientAuth wildcard; the requested EKU is retained and this limitation is recorded. Prior certificates remain historical valid certificates; no revocation was requested in this revision.
